contract.phase_order: Native particle calculation then native centroid calculation; the following particle phase occurs on the next tick.
contract.motion_state: Stored numerical history read/updated within active work; retain the same activity bit for changing state and consume it for a fixed full position/velocity state.
contract.contact_order: Contact forces retain pre-integration evaluation. Peer activity writes occur after all particle calculations/consumption; newly touched stationary peers do not relay touches.
contract.centroid_order: Consume qualified centroid bits before activating particles; unqualified centroid bits are consumed by the numerical gate.
contract.extra_scheduler_state: No duplicate particle bank, epoch, timestamp or custom queue.

native_functions.purpose: Type-specific active traversal; compiler supplies native list clear/generation.
Native pointer allocation and bitmasked atomic activation/consumption; no dummy marker writes.
Pad physical pointer capacity; preserve logical counts and leave padding inactive.

native_contract.phase_and_payload: Particle consumption/carried activity, centroid consumption/reactivation, no early particle calculation and sleeping-member contributions verified.

layout_probe.boundary: Bounded CPU observation on pinned fork. Unpadded non-power-of-two traversal is not qualified; no vendor change or universal GPU claim.

numeric_control.coordinate_frame: Nearby supplied double reference subtracted before f32 projection; local motion and centroid expectations at offsets 0 and 2^27 retained.

measurement_boundary: Named body/adjacency counts exclude some list-generation/mask and propagation bookkeeping instructions; wall time includes launch/synchronization/reporting. No speedup or logarithmic bound asserted.
